verdict_on_divergence.mechanism: In all 9 diverging configurations, sw_purchase_approved was set to True at Day 9 Hour 6 despite the land order being dropped due to the  reserve. This leaked into subsequent turns, modifying MacroPlanner internal holds, wheat purchases, and pasture timing.
verdict_on_divergence.7084_dollar_outlier: In Seed 96502 melon_sniper Seat 0, the omission of a 3-unit wheat buy at Step 242 allowed Treatment to preserve cash and avoid a sheep purchase that Control executed. Later, town melon market prices spiked, and Treatment had greater inventory slack to sell melons at peak prices. This was an accidental artifact of failed purchase lockup, not a strategic benefit of withholding SW expansion.

diverging_configurations.root_cause: sw_purchase_approved=True set at step 222 (D9 H6) persisted even after BUY_LAND was dropped. MacroPlanner feed calculation and budget holds in Treatment diverged from Control because sw_purchase_approved altered strategic holding states and discretionary purchasing.
